summary: Equinox Gold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 29, 2026 press release reporting exploration drilling results at its Canadian mines. The release details intercepts including 22.9 m @ 10.00 g/t Au at Musselwhite and 27.3 m @ 2.11 g/t Au at the new Minotaur discovery at Valentine, plus early Greenstone holes with assays pending. The company reports roughly 308,000 metres drilled year-to-date across nine projects, 45 active rigs, and a 2026 exploration budget of about US$155 million with 477,000 metres planned. No securities transaction, board recommendation, or special situation is involved. No deal terms stated.
